summary: All 6 fixes from this session validated. Backend: 14/14 new tests pass + previously-passing 20/20 from iter23 (total 34/34). Masters API has zero duplicate (value_lower, parent_lower) groups across all 7 types (religion, caste, language, occupation, skill, drive, trait). Caste cascade by parent=Hindu returns only Hindu-parent castes and no duplicates. POST /api/masters returns 409 on case-insensitive duplicates within the same (type,parent) scope, but correctly allows same value under a different parent (e.g. caste 'X' under Hindu and Christian). Dedup migration ran cleanly on boot (no errors in backend logs). Contacts POST/GET round-trip preserves profile_image (data:image/png;base64 data-URI) in both detail and list endpoints. Frontend: Contacts header back-arrow now renders DARK (#1E293B) on the white gradient header in contacts.tsx, ctt.tsx and ctt-task.tsx — visually verified on /tools/contacts. Contacts list card shows H-initials avatar fallback when no profile_image (verified for the seed user 'Hardening Test') — list-cards layout is correct. New Contact modal autosuggest UX verified: (a) Religion is single-select; type 'Hin' shows exactly 1 'Hindu' option plus an 'Add "Hin"' free-type row; selecting Hindu collapses to a removable chip. (b) Caste cascades on Hindu parent: type 'br' shows only Hindu-parent castes (Bairagi Brahmin, Brahmin, Golconda Vyapari Brahmin, Kanyakubja Brahmin) + 'Add "br"' free-type row. (c) Occupation MasterSelect on Professional tab: empty-focus hides the long list (0 suggestions visible — matches the 'hide if >30 and empty query' rule); typing 'accoun' filters to 'Accountant' + 'Add "accoun"' with no duplicates. Solution Finder: progress-bar step dots have NO pencil badge (only the step icon). Step 2 RCA rows render an inline editable TextInput with leading pencil icon (lines 595–603 in solution-finder.tsx), and Step 4 Mitigation (b) and Contingency (c) rows do the same (lines 806–813 and 849–856). One pre-existing React Native web console warning observed but not regressing: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — not introduced this session; flagging for tracking.
